title: Grateful Dead Live at Meramec Community College on 1970-05-14
source: Set 2 Source: Soundboard > Reel Master > DAT (48k)

ai_review.summary: Fair soundboard recording with pitch fluctuations and out‑of‑tune guitars, capturing an average‑to‑above‑average show highlighted by a sparse Candyman and Jerry’s slide on Speedway.
ai_review.review: The performance sits in the middle of the spring ’70 era – a short first set and a marathon second set that delivers moments like a great Candyman arrangement and a solid Rider, but is hampered by occasional tuning slips and uneven energy. The SBD source suffers from speed/pitch inconsistencies, tape wow and a few cuts, making the listening experience only fair despite the historical value of the first Attics of My Life and the NRPS interlude.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is judged average‑to‑above‑average (≈3/5) while recording quality is fair (≈2.5/5); weighted together (70% show, 30% recording) yields about 3.6 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Fluctuating speed/pitch requiring correction, occasional tape wow, guitars noticeably out of tune on several songs, minor cut in Schoolgirl, overall decent but inconsistent clarity.

poor_songs: St. Stephen (not up to era standards)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Short, technically problematic first set followed by a lengthy second set with NRPS intermission; overall pacing is uneven but contains several high points.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Nice slide at the end of Speedway; some guitars out of tune on multiple numbers.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey does not play in the acoustic set (alternating with Billy) but drums otherwise solid.
